QuestInfo.name: The Value of One Scale
QuestInfo.0: You may be able to confirm whether #p1013000# is really an Onyx Dragon with just one scale. Ask #b#p1013000##k to give you one scale.
QuestInfo.1:
#p1013000# says his scales don't come off unless he's healthy. He needs some protein and calcium to get his strength back. He says #b#t4000760#s#k and #b#t4000761##k from #b#o3401007##k and #b#o3401008##k are just what he needs.


#i4000760# #t4000760# #b#c4000760# / 25#k
#i4000761# #t4000761# #b#c4000761# / 25#k
QuestInfo.2: You fed him #t4000760# and #t4000761#, and #p1013000# shed another scale! Hope that's the last one.

0.0: Ma... Master, why are you looking at me like that?\r\n#L0##bYou heard, didn't you? I need one of your scales. Give me one.#l\n#k
0.1: You want one of my scales? How could you say something so cruel with a straight face, master? Do you know how painful that would be?\r\n#L0##bWell, not really, but there is no other way for us to identify which family of Dragons you belong to. Come on now, hurry.#l\n#k
0.2: No way! I can't do that! How could you try to take one of my pretty and perfect scales? Think about it, master. How pathetic would you feel if you had a bald spot?\r\n#L0##bA scale isn't like hair. I can take one from your body where it wouldn't be so noticeable. #l\n#k
0.3: Wahhh, don't say that with such a happy face! I'm scared! Can't I give you something else? \r\n#L0##bSomething else... Like your horn?#l\n#k
0.4: Yikes! My horn? Of course not! Fine, just take a scale! But I have to consume enough calcium for my DEF to compensate for the loss of my scale.

yes.0: Seafood! I'm gonna eat seafood! Get me #b25#k #r#t4000760#s#k and #b25#k #r#t4000761##k in #b#m120040000##k, and I'll give you one of my scales.
yes.1: #b#t4000760##k and #b#t4000761##k are from #r#o3401007#s#k and #r#o3401008##k. Now leave me... I must decide which scale I can bear to lose.

no.0: Absolutely not, then! I don't care if you're my master, I can't just give you a scale. No way!

1.0: D-did you already get the #t4000760# and #t4000761#? Already? Ugh, I'm not sure I'm ready...

yes.0: *sniff* Here is my scale. My precious scale. Please be careful with that. Okay? I'm not giving you another one.

item.0: Where are the #b#t4000760##k and #b#t4000761##k? I can't give you my scale until you give me #r25 of each#k!
